user.title: pax0r's Listkeeper
user.description: Opt in only the lists you want Listkeeper to manage. Shopping List and Local To-do are supported. Each list has its own catalog and history. Leave SQL URL blank for automatic detection; SQLite uses a separate file.

init.description: Only selected lists are managed. Removing a selection stops processing and retains its data. An empty SQL URL preserves the connection; reset restores detection. Changing databases does not transfer history.
